Quantitative comparison offered as evidence to justify the adoption decision; the performance claim also positions the speaker as possessing technical knowledge.
Supplying a timeline as established fact; controlling the factual frame around when the decision takes effect.
Summary note recording the database decision as a settled fact; informational control over what was decided.
Restating the performance metric as a summary point; the quantified benefit functions as evidence-based justification.
Recording the timeline as a settled fact in summary form; informational control over the schedule.
